modifications: Upstream executable, launcher and libraries are unchanged. Installation replaces the bundled example plugin, extension and automation-script directories with empty directories. A separate launcher initializes the profile and retries one early desktop startup crash. A separate process guard confines writes to profile/document directories and restricts child executables; upstream files remain unchanged.
configuration: First-launch setup completed; welcome and update dialogs, developer mode, autosave and backup disabled; local saving selected. Conversion commands use a separate profile and desktop session.
